crossRefs.note: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and…
There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from…

translations.web: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?
translations.bsb: Surely hope of overcoming him is false. Is not the sight of him overwhelming?
translations.kjv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not one be cast down even at the sight
translations.asv: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: Will not one be cast down even at the sight of him?
